_note: Street, ownership, events, industry and regulation, critiques, gaps and conflicts as of 30-Sep-2026. Notes and facts published after 30-Sep-2026 are excluded (see updates/later-facts.json).

street._method: Brokers that disclose a method value HDB on P/B on FY28E book: Motilal Oswal 2.3x Mar-28E BVPS, Emkay 2.2x FY28E (Jun-27 target), Nomura 2.3x Jun-28F, Jefferies 2.5x Jun-28E (Apr-2026), Equirus 2.5x FY28E adjusted book (Apr-2026); ICICI Securities used 3x Sep-27E book (Apr-2026); Nirmal Bang uses residual income (implied 2.3x FY28E book); Goldman Sachs' Aug-2025 initiation used 2.8x FY27E book or 19x FY27E EPS.

brokers.thesis: Credit demand holds; unsecured business and personal loans staging a gradual comeback; asset quality stabilising
Top pick: beats on income, PPOP and PAT; improving asset quality and capital; liquidity supports margins
Upgrade: asset quality improved meaningfully in a seasonally weak quarter; ROE 14% → 16.8% by FY29E; EPS CAGR 26% FY26-29E
Growth recovers to 18-19%; credit cost falls to 2.1% by FY28E (latest note we found)
Cyclical recovery under way (Apr-2026: 2.1x FY28E, ₹710); target raised after Q1 per a Mint report we could not open
Initiation: PAT CAGR 24% FY25-28E; no later note found
Initiation: AUM CAGR 19% FY26-28E; no later note found
2.5% ROA for two quarters; credit cost 2.4% vs management's 2.3% aim; stock at 2.5x forward book
AUM CAGR 18% and PAT CAGR 27% FY26-28E; FY28 ROE 16%
Portfolio reset done and disbursements recovering, but the valuation already prices 15-18% growth; wants loan growth to show first
Good quarter, but peers grow faster; a re-rating needs a material pickup in growth without slippage

consensus.note: Our tally of the 12 targets standing on 30-Sep-2026 (some stale: Goldman, BofA, Jefferies, Equirus). No dated full-year consensus EPS found. Bloomberg consensus P/B of 2.3x FY27E and 2.0x FY28E at ₹644 was quoted by SBI Securities on 16-Apr-2026 (BusinessToday).

ownership.parentShares: ~61.5 cr shares (615,461,535 per an Apr-2026 takeover-code filing seen only as a search snippet; equals 74.1% of 83.03 cr)
ownership.lockIns: Anchor lock-ins ended Jul/Sep-2025; the six-month lock-in on 48.15 cr shares (58% of equity) ended 2-Jan-2026 (Nuvama via Angel One). HDFC Bank has made no statement about selling more; public float is 25.9%, so the 25% rule forces nothing.

events.title: Listing
events.detail: Listed at ₹835 vs ₹740 issue price (+12.8%); IPO 16.7x subscribed (QIBs 55.5x, retail 1.4x).

events.title: RBI drops the bank-group overlap restriction
events.detail: Governor: the restriction 'is being removed from the final guidelines'; allocation of businesses left to bank boards. HDB +2-3% on the day.

events.title: Six-month lock-in ends
events.detail: 48.15 cr shares (58% of equity) become tradable.

events.title: Chairman resigns
events.detail: Independent chairman Arijit Basu resigned; stock ₹766 → ₹695 that week.
events.src: Annual Report FY2025-26 (secretarial audit report); Screener weekly prices

events.title: Post-listing low
events.detail: ₹579 weekly close after a March sell-off (West Asia conflict, fuel prices); 1.8x forward book.

events.title: Q1FY27 results
events.detail: Record PAT ₹785 cr (+38%), Stage 3 2.34%, NIM 8.35%, ROA 2.5%; loans +11.4%.

events.title: Upper-layer list 2026-27
events.detail: HDB remains an upper-layer NBFC (bank-like rules).

events.title: IRDAI consultation on loan-linked insurance
events.detail: Proposes commission caps of ~2-5% on credit-linked insurance sold by lenders; comments to 25-Oct-2026. HDB earned ₹455 cr of insurance commission in FY26 (13% of PBT).

events.title: CRISIL reaffirms AAA/Stable; company secretary resigns
events.detail: CRISIL reaffirmed AAA/Stable/A1+; the company secretary and head of legal resigned with effect from 30-Oct-2026 (reason not stated).

market.detail: September 2026 sell-off: Nifty and Sensex down ~5% for the month by 28-Sep on foreign selling, Brent ~$106 and US 10-year yields at 5.2%; most economists polled expected a 25bp repo hike to 5.5%. HDB fell from ₹698 (18-Sep) to ₹621 (30-Sep).

regulatory: Bank-like governance, capital and disclosure; mandatory listing within three years
On every list since 2022, incl. 2026-27 (6-Aug-2026); listed Jul-2025
Forced the IPO; caps how loosely it can run

One entity per business 'as a principle'; a second entity allowed with a board-recorded rationale; group NBFCs follow bank-style loan restrictions (no loans against the parent's shares, to its directors, for land acquisition; caps on loans against shares, IPO and ESOP funding)
Overlap with HDFC Bank (car, two-wheeler, personal and business loans) allowed with a rationale; the restricted loan types are not HDB's business
The Oct-2024 draft (no overlap at all) was the IPO's biggest overhang; it was dropped on 1-Oct-2025
Bank investment limits in the same directions
A bank's investment in a group entity above 20% needs prior RBI approval; action plan by 31-Mar-2026, compliance by 31-Mar-2028
Any new equity from HDFC Bank needs RBI approval; we assume none
Caps of ~2-5% on commissions for loan-linked insurance
Insurance commission ₹455 cr in FY26 (FY25 ₹277 cr)
We cut a third of it from FY28E (−0.13% of AUM), as in our Cholamandalam report

industry.context: NBFCs lending to small businesses, truckers and consumers grew faster than banks in FY23-FY25, then slowed in FY26 as unsecured business loans, microfinance and parts of vehicle finance went through a credit cycle. HDB itself cut back used and high-value commercial vehicles and unsecured business loans in FY26 (AUM +10.7%). Listed lenders fell 4-16% between 31-Jul and 30-Sep-2026.
industry.src: q4call, q1call; Cholamandalam report (market context, Upstox 28-Sep-2026)

Nomura (credit cost 2.4% vs 2.3%), Q1FY27 call questions

Nirmal Bang, ICICI Securities, foreign broker (Overweight)

Vertical loan book at Sep-25 (only shares in a chart); FY24 and earlier vertical split not on file.

conflicts: Screener's quarterly 'Gross NPA %' runs one quarter behind the company's Stage 3 (e.g. Jun-2026: Screener 2.81%, company 2.34%); we use the company's figures.
Screener FY26 interest ₹6,856 cr vs reported finance cost ₹6,820 cr (Screener moves ~₹35 cr from other expenses); expenses differ by the same amount; PBT ties.
FY26 EPS: Screener ₹30.64 (year-end shares) vs reported basic ₹30.97 (weighted average shares).
IPO subscription: 16.69x (BusinessToday, final) vs ~17.65x (5 pm snapshot, other outlets).
Borrowings at Jun-2025: ₹91,472 cr in the Q1FY26 and Q3FY26 presentations vs ₹92,230 cr in the Q1FY27 chart; we use balance-sheet values.
Q2FY26 loan-loss provision (₹748 cr) is derived as FY26 less the other three quarters.
